exposure: HIV-infected pregnant women's age at delivery
cohort: All HIV-infected pregnant women with delivery in Campo Grande-MS, Brazil, between 2007-2013, and their HIV-exposed infants.
finding: The overall vertical HIV transmission rate in Campo Grande-MS was 8.7% and increased over the study period, indicating that recommended interventions were not fully adopted.
followup_time: Up to 8 years (observations for infants born between 2007-2013 continued until July 2015)
